text:
lena_sales: Passing AstraLink to CS. Pilot signed; main asks: embeddings-heavy (~1.8M tokens/month), Okta SSO, customer-managed KMS, wants Private VPC evaluation in ~7 weeks. Renewal convo scheduled for 75 days. Drive: https://drive.internal/astralink/contract.pdf. Who owns rollout and next steps?

maria_cs: I'll take lead. Can we do a 30m kickoff Wed 9am PT? Need p99 target, expected QPS, and sample prompts.

ops-bot: Created CS-9001 and support ticket ENG-4210. Kickoff scheduled Wed 09:00 PT.

samir_support: Note: Private requires support addendum + SRE runbook. We'll need network contact, infra diagram, and telemetry endpoints. Opening infra-handoff subtask.

kai_eng: Runtime planning: for p99 <=200ms at 60 concurrent qps recommend 2xA10-equivalent with autoscaling. Need avg/peak seq length and embedding dim. If retrieval-heavy, plan KV cache and shard pinning.

lena_sales: Customer target p99 160ms for requests <512 tokens, bursts to 90 qps, embedding dim 1024. I'll upload Okta metadata and prompt CSV by EOD.

anya_cs_manager: Flagging RENEWAL_RISK. If onboarding slips past 6 weeks, propose a short Dedicated trial (10 days) to keep momentum. Maria, please tag RISK and start RevOps approval for credits.

maria_cs: Marked CS-9001 RISK and requested RevOps approval. Samir, can support cover monitoring for the trial window?

samir_support: We can cover monitoring for a 10-day trial provided we get read-only access to their telemetry stack and the runbook is complete. We'll log monitoring tasks under ENG-4210.

kai_eng: Once prompts are uploaded I'll run a perf sweep in staging and post results to ENG-4210. If memory per replica >10GB we may recommend quantization + batching adjustments.

lena_sales: Uploaded prompts + Okta metadata. Invited AstraLink devs to kickoff.

maria_cs: Owners: maria_cs (CS lead), samir_support (support), kai_eng (runtime), lena_sales (sales contact). Next steps: 1) Customer provides SSO metadata + KMS key ARN; 2) SRE provision staging private pool (2 GPUs) for smoke; 3) Kai runs perf sweep and posts results; 4) Schedule enablement session with AstraLink devs; 5) RevOps decision on trial credits. Target go-live window: 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-29.

ops-bot: CS-9001 linked to ENG-4210. Reminders set for next milestones.

anya_cs_manager: Please keep me posted on perf. If p99 >220ms escalate for prioritization. Good work team.

maria_cs: Will update after kickoff. Closing loop here for now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
